//@version=6
indicator("V52 array-bool-join-method", calc_bars_count=32)
values = array.from(true, false, true)
string joined = values.join("|")
plot(bar_index, "INDEX", display=display.data_window)
plot(str.length(joined), "TEXT_LENGTH", display=display.data_window)
plot(joined == "true|false|true" ? 1 : 0, "MATCH_LITERAL", display=display.data_window)
if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory
    log.info("JOIN_TEXT={0}", joined)
